threads.body: For self-hosted runners, it’s safer/more explicit to include the `self-hosted` label in `runs-on` (e.g. `runs-on: [self-hosted, cncf-ubuntu-2-8-x86]`). This avoids any future ambiguity if a GitHub-hosted runner label ever overlaps and makes the intent clear to tooling/readers.
threads.hunk:
@@ -20,7 +20,7 @@ jobs:
   # new tox env automatically extends CI without editing workflow YAML.
   prepare:
     name: prepare-matrix
-    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    runs-on: cncf-ubuntu-2-8-x86

threads.body: The runner label is duplicated across many workflows, which makes future runner migrations/error fixes repetitive. Consider centralizing the runner label via a repo/org variable (e.g. `vars.LINUX_RUNNER`) and using an expression in `runs-on`, so it can be changed in one place.
